title: Update Check Result
description: Mirrors agent/updates.CheckResult (agent/updates/manager.go) -- one component's CHECK outcome, used by GET /api/v1/versions, GET /api/v1/updates, and POST /api/v1/updates/check|plan.

check_error.description: set when the manifest fetch itself failed (network, signature, replay) -- distinct from blocked, which means the check succeeded but policy says no.
